verdict.rationale: Ashby ships an in-product agent (Ashby Assistant with custom agents), so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence only documents Ashby's own MCP server, which exposes Ashby data to outside clients like Claude and Cursor. That is the server role, not the client capability this story asks about. Nothing shows Ashby Assistant can connect to third-party MCP servers or use their tools.
